county-volunteer-captain.weeklyExpectation: 3–5 hours · monthly call + 3 volunteer check-ins + 1 event confirmed on Mobilize
county-volunteer-captain.firstAction: Identify 3 people in your county who could volunteer and send a personal invitation this week.
firstWeekTasks: Complete county captain training packet
Review your county playbook in Election Plan
Schedule intro call with campaign ops
Recruit first volunteer or confirm county chair relationship
Create or audit Mobilize event for next local opportunity

expectationSheet.monthly: 1 county call · 2 local events · 1 house party target
expectationSheet.reporting: Weekly activity report to volunteer lead

lte-coordinator.weeklyExpectation: 2–3 hours · coach 1 writer · log submissions · pursue 1 publication
lte-coordinator.firstAction: Pick one tier-2 or tier-3 newspaper in your county and read its LTE guidelines today.
firstWeekTasks: Complete LTE workflow training (7 steps)
Identify 3 potential citizen writers (not campaign staff)
Log your newspaper in Citizen Voices registry
Draft writer recruitment message
Schedule first writer coaching call

campus-captain.weeklyExpectation: 3–5 hours · recruit 2 students · advance Freshman Week checklist
campus-captain.firstAction: Walk your campus student union or tabling location and identify where Kelly registration table goes in August.
firstWeekTasks: Complete campus captain binder review
Identify 5 student leaders to recruit
Confirm Freshman Week readiness status for your campus
Create Mobilize event draft for first tabling shift
Email campus network lead with your commitment

expectationSheet.reporting: Campus network lead · Students for Arkansas

story-corps-lead.weeklyExpectation: 2–4 hours · 2 edited assets · 1 filming opportunity scouted
story-corps-lead.firstAction: Film 60 seconds of B-roll at the next Kelly stop or local event you attend.
firstWeekTasks: Review Story Corps team doctrine
Confirm vertical video kit access or phone setup
Deliver 1 test reel with captions
Coordinate with Leann on publishing pipeline
Identify backup shooter in your region

expectationSheet.monthly: 5 assets per Kelly stop in your area

power-of-5-leader.weeklyExpectation: 2–4 hours · 2 meaningful conversations · 1 follow-up · 1 host ask
power-of-5-leader.firstAction: Write down five people you know who trust you and would take your call about civic participation.
firstWeekTasks: Complete Po5 doctrine training
Hold 2 meaningful conversations using three asks
Log conversations in Po5 tracker
Identify 1 potential house party host
Commit to 5 Po5 introductions this month

faith-outreach-lead.firstAction: List 3 faith community connectors in your county you could ask for a listening conversation.
firstWeekTasks: Review Big Table welcome & respectful framing
Schedule first faith community listening session
Log contact in coalition tracker
Share faith outreach scripts with county captain
Identify 1 validator endorsement pathway

union-outreach-lead.weeklyExpectation: 2–4 hours · 1 union/labor touchpoint · briefing packet shared
union-outreach-lead.firstAction: Confirm attendance at the next Democratic Union Caucus or local union meeting in your region.
firstWeekTasks: Read labor program briefing packet
Introduce yourself to Danny Brown / labor lead
Schedule first union meeting or hall visit
Prepare working-class kitchen table message
Log introduction for follow-up

mobilize-lead.weeklyExpectation: 2–3 hours · audit 7-day calendar · publish 3 Mobilize pages
mobilize-lead.firstAction: Audit the next 7 days of field calendar and flag any stop missing a Mobilize event.
firstWeekTasks: Complete Mobilize enforcement rules training
Audit next 14 days of field calendar
Create Mobilize events for all gaps
Assign volunteer shifts for next qualifying stop
Report zero Missing Mobilize warnings to Steve

house-party-host.weeklyExpectation: One event + 2 hours prep · 8–15 guests · 5 Po5 asks
house-party-host.firstAction: Pick a date in the next 30 days and text 3 people: "Would you help me host neighbors to meet Kelly's campaign?"
firstWeekTasks: Review house party host kit
Confirm date and guest target list (8–15)
Create Mobilize invite page
Coordinate with county captain or Po5 leader
Prepare opening welcome and three asks
